description: This file contains unit tests for the ProjectActivityDao class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically testing CRUD operations and various retrieval methods for project activities.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectActivityDao data access object within the OrangeHRM Time plugin module, covering CRUD and retrieval operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data from the fixture file.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of project activities by project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityListByFilterProjectActivityName
methods.description: Tests filtering project activities by name.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: testSaveProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests saving a new project activity.

methods.name: testEditProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project activity.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a project activity throws a ProjectServiceException.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivityNameValidation
methods.description: Tests validation logic for project activity name uniqueness.

methods.name: testGetDuplicatedActivityIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of duplicated activity IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivitiesByProjectIds
methods.description: Tests bulk retrieval of project activities by multiple project IDs.

methods.name: testSaveCopyActivity
methods.description: Tests copying activities from one project to another.
